manual_visual_review.source_channel_result: Insufficient improvement. Four published handles are not a complete semantic separation.
manual_visual_review.wplus_result: Visible reduction in added glasses on multiple portraits. -8 leaves transparent lens/bridge residue on61908 and visible glasses on64919/67140; -12 removes more but changes the eye region and reduces apparent age.
manual_visual_review.existing_glasses_control: Native crop review at7.5 and10 confirms frames remain visible on65817 even at-12; thickness/shape change. Do not claim complete removal or reliable preservation.
manual_visual_review.stylespace_negative_result: No reliable added-glasses removal; some frames become more visible or change shape.
manual_visual_review.remaining_failures: White hair/beard/hat loss on68335, low cross-age identity and individual regressions remain.
manual_visual_review.auto_score_visual_pending_note: summary.visual_review_pending is the automatic-scoring checkpoint; this separate manual review does not promote any route.
